query: db.accounts.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "quarter": 1 }, output: { running_total: { $avg: "$balance", window: { documents: ["unbounded", "current"] } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, company: 1, balance: "$balance", running_total: 1 } }])

db.accounts.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "quarter": 1 }, output: { running_total: { $sum: "$balance", window: { documents: [0, "current"] } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, company: 1, balance: "$balance", running_total: 1 } }])
